payload.text:
No theme surface puts an external reference into the artifact: an absolute scheme anywhere in live text, or a protocol-relative target at a reference site, is a build error wherever a theme can express one. THE SURFACES ARE THE INSTANCES AND NOT THE CRITERION -- the previous wording said 'in CSS and in theme.yaml', which is an enumeration, and the code was already broader than it (see AC-3.13). Implements R2 and R3; CLOSES issues 0014, 0015 and 0017. The CSS half landed 2026-09-09 (cd0412d), reading the sites as TOKENS rather than as spellings, after cc measured a needle list deciding 8 of 13 references wrongly with every one of the 8 shipping its reference into the artifact. The theme.yaml half is R3 and is NOT blocked on the manifest existing -- themes/popupart/theme.yaml exists today, is read at showreel:198, and carries favicon: and fonts[].file, which are exactly the reference-bearing fields -- it is blocked on WP-03's YAML loader. The row therefore stays unsatisfied with half of it built, and is NOT split by surface: one property, one row.

STATUS 2026-09-09, CORRECTED BY vc AGAINST vc: R2 IS BUILT AND VERIFIED, R3 IS NOT, AND THIS ROW WAS WRONGLY MARKED SATISFIED FOR ROUGHLY AN HOUR. R2 landed at cc 538e7fe and vc verified it at the artifact in four arms with exit codes read out of band: a clean layout.html builds at exit 0; issue 0018's bypass fixture -- a live href between a stray /* on line 1 and a */ on line 3 -- REFUSES at exit 2 with no artifact, naming layout.html, the http:// scheme and LINE 2, which can only be reported if the line-1 marker stripped nothing; a /* */ attribution in theme.js refuses at exit 2, the loud cost; the same in theme.css builds at exit 0, so the CSS exemption survives. That verification stands and is kept here rather than lost with the evidence. R3 IS UNBUILT: theme.yaml is a FOURTH surface, refuse_external has THREE call sites, and nothing scans the theme manifest at all. A remote URL there resolves as tdir / "https://...", does not exist, and the loader warns and continues -- so THE OFFLINE GUARANTEE HOLDS BY ACCIDENT OF PATH RESOLUTION RATHER THAN BY THE CHECK THAT IS SUPPOSED TO HOLD IT, which is IN-AG-NO-SILENT-001. The live example exists and is not hypothetical: popupart/theme.yaml is read at showreel:198 and carries favicon: and fonts[].file, precisely the reference-bearing fields. HOW vc GOT IT WRONG, BECAUSE THE TELL IS IN THIS ROW'S OWN TEXT: the row says it implements R2 AND R3, and vc verified R2's three surfaces exhaustively and never asked what R3 was. The four arms were complete for the code's reach and answered nothing about the row's. THIS ROW ALREADY CARRIED THE SENTENCE 'THE SURFACES ARE THE INSTANCES AND NOT THE CRITERION', WRITTEN BY vc THIS MORNING, AND vc THEN GRADED IT AGAINST THE INSTANCES. design.md also states the disposition plainly -- that the right outcome for a half-built row is that it stays unsatisfied, which is what cc did rather than asking for a mark -- so the correct answer was written down in two places before the error was made. UNBLOCKED NOW: R3 waited on WP-03's own YAML loader with a live example to test against, and cc reports that loader exists, with the loader living in showreel so artifact stays at zero dependencies and AC02's sign-off is untouched. Discharged when theme.yaml joins the scanned set and a reference-bearing field in it is refused by name.
